## Activity

During December 2022, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 64 captures. Activity was completed as part of the site’s routine service delivery, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. No additional operational issues are noted in the available information.

## Image quality

Of the 64 captures, 4 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 6.2 per cent. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity when reviewing image acquisition and service performance. Ungradable images could not be included in the grading assessment, and may warrant routine review through established quality processes.

## Grading

There were 8 referable results during December 2022. The median grading lag was 2 days. This indicates that the central point of the grading waiting time distribution was 2 days for the month. The grading results and image-quality measure should be reviewed together to support ongoing monitoring of the service at Oakridge Primary Care.
